# Redis Cache Infrastructure Documentation

> Caching layer for the ecosystem

## Overview

Redis provides caching, session storage, and message brokering for the ecosystem.

## Configuration Files

The actual Redis configuration is in the `compose/cache/` directory:

```
└── (Redis configuration files)
```
